checked_decisions.finding: Voice-only taunt before the Blue Hawk of Giganos (Meio Plato) is visually identified at 2621-2624. Gender-neutral 'that one' for source yatsu confirmed correct: the reveal structure withholds identity from the player at this point in the table, matching the precedent in review_01073 (row 1073) of not supplying an unstated identity/gender.
Squad/waypoint callsigns Yamabuki Squad, Orange Vermilion, Red, Blue, Point R confirmed against orchestrator ruling: accepted as literal ACE3-original callsigns, no glossary entry required.

'Giganos army'/'Giganos-army' for Giganos-gun checked against the corpus: only one prior instance exists (dialogue_01486, batch_01426, 'Giganos forces'), not a locked term and not a majority. Left as the translator's literal rendering; flagging alongside the translator's own note for an orchestrator terminology pass rather than unilaterally normalizing from a single data point.
Eureka/Nirvash spellings confirmed against character_names_021.json and unit_names_014_b.json. No pronoun invented for Eureka; source has none and none was needed.
Blue Hawk of Giganos / Meio Plato reveal sequence checked word-for-word against source; 'he' at 2623 matches source 彼 (already gendered in the Japanese), not an invented pronoun.
Bare 'Federation' (no book tag) confirmed correct: source line 宇宙の民を苦しめ続ける連邦を打倒すべく has no book/color wrapper here, unlike the book(9)-tagged Federation references at 2672/2676/2687 in the next slice.

'遅かりし復讐人、未熟者よ。滅。' rendered as two independent-clause vocatives ('Too late, avenger; you're still unripe. Perish.') instead of one compound noun phrase; same two attributes (belated, immature) applied to the same addressee, meaning unchanged. Left as merely differently phrased.

uncertainties.issue: Giganos-gun rendered 'Giganos army'; the only other corpus occurrence of this noun (dialogue_01486) uses 'Giganos forces'. Not enough data to call either one a majority; not fixed here since this is a common-noun phrasing choice, not a name error, but the two forms should eventually be reconciled by an orchestrator terminology pass.

Rows contain lowercase j or q outside a locked name (e.g. 'adjust', 'squads', 'objective', 'justice'; 'quick turn' at 2574/2575 is the terms_028.json-locked exception). Not rewritten: this is a meaning-only pass, rewriting for glyph avoidance risks changing register for no meaning gain, and the already-reviewed batch_01073 corpus tolerates the same pattern (4 of 80 rows). Flagging for whoever runs a dedicated font/style pass.
